question: Akham Lakshmi Devi received the sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for her contribution to ______.
solution:
Correct Answer** Manipuri Dance**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shrimati Akham Lakshmi Devi** was born on** May 1, 1952, **in Imphal, Manipur.
 
• She received her training in Manipuri dance from Gurus Amubi Singh, Tomba Singh, and Th. Babu Singh.
 
• She specialized in Manipuri dance at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy in Imphal.
 
• Shrimati Akham Lakshmi Devi has performed in various prestigious dance festivals, including the Bhagyachandra national dance festival and those organized by the Manipur **State Kala Akademi and Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
 
• Her performances in dance productions by the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy, such as Keibul Lamjao, Ramayan, Lei Langba, Moirang Sha, and Geet Govinda, have received critical acclaim.
 
• She has received several honors, including the** Manipur State Kala Akademi Award in 2010 and the Nritya Bhusan in 2014.**
 
• Shrimati Akham Lakshmi Devi was awarded the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for her significant contributions to Manipuri dance.**
